title: The Hawk and Azure Venom Mastery
summary: A mastery of venom that falls from above like a hawk and ends in a sting no guard or hide can turn.

title: Treatise of the Twin Scorpion Tails
summary: A treatise on two barbed tails of venom that lash and pinch and hold and close on one fatal verdict.

title: The Paired Mercury Canon
summary: A canon of heavy bright venom that runs in two beads and binds and pierces and slips through the strongest guard.

title: Manual of the Dual Bane Course
summary: A manual of the paired arts of bane and wort: the same hand that lays a toxin lifts it and drinks in the rest.

title: The Twin Antidote Mastery
summary: A mastery of remedies given in pairs that treat the poisoned and turn the foe's own toxin into a thing that heals.

title: The Wind-Sworn Bane Mastery
summary: A mastery of bane carried on the wind in needles and gusts and squalls that a sworn poisoner steers by oath.

title: Treatise of the Patient Widow
summary: A treatise on the web and the waiting bite: a trap of silk and venom that rewards stillness and ends in one embrace.

title: The Oath of the Rotting Wind
summary: A text on a wind that carries decay across the field and a vow that its sworn bearer can walk through it unharmed.

title: Manual of the Bearing Sting
summary: A manual of the single sting taken on a true bearing: long study of the foe and then one stroke that is never repeated.

title: The Open-Sky Poisoner's Oath
summary: A text that makes venom a vow of the open sky: nothing hidden and nothing walled and a toxin that is declared before it is used.
